summary: Don't rely on sensory cues: avoid instructions based only on color, shape or position, and ensure sufficient contrast in images.
questions: Can I say 'click the blue button' in docs?
What accessibility rules apply to colors in docs?

answer_card.title: Color and visual information
answer_card.answer_md:
- Don't write "Click the square, blue button".
- Don't convey meaning by color alone.
- Keep enough contrast in images and diagrams.
- Navigation instructions must work without left/right/above/below.
